product.name: Financial Projections
product.description: A tool for financial modeling, reporting, and forecasting that replaces spreadsheets with an integrated platform.

product.name: Hiring Plan
product.description: A recruitment planning tool that tracks current employees and forecasts new hires with associated costs.

product.name: Scenario Planning
product.description: A tool to create and compare multiple financial scenarios to prepare for different business outcomes.

product.description: A customizable dashboard that visualizes financial data and key performance indicators with interactive charts.
